reason: My regulars and Google reviews bring my customers, and my WhatsApp group handles offers. I have never used creators, and I won't hand my counter and staff over to a beta app from people I don't know just because it's free.
objection: Who are you? A small team in beta can shut down in three months, and then my staff are confused, the coupons people are holding don't work, and the regulars blame me. And free usually means they make money off me somehow later.
would_change_my_mind: Another café or darshini owner near me telling me in person that a creator post through Mitra brought them real customers they could match in their bill book.
